methodology.announcement: captured separately then dismissed via its close button; cookie consent rejected before the measured run
methodology.scroll: window.scrollTo with scroll-behavior:auto, two rAF plus ~80 ms settle
methodology.time: target offsets 0/250/500/750/1000/1500/2000/3000/5000 ms; elapsedMs is the measured pre-screenshot time

scenes.name: announcement
scenes.description: Announcement card load/entry/dismiss. Entry is delayed by the site until hydration; load frames are relative to navigation commit, entry/dismiss frames are exact CSS-transition states extracted by pausing and stepping the transition instead of racing screenshot latency.
